lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 semi-regular horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from higher density near the gills to a structured grid-like arrangement posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like network of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light highlights on the superior edge and localized shadows on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical notch or laceration is visible on the posterior edge of the final gill slit (indicated by a large graphical arrow); two smaller irregular dark-toned cutaneous lesions or pigment deviations are present in the mid-flank area (indicated by smaller graphical arrows).
other_distinctive_markers: A highly irregular, non-linear cluster of high-luminance spots is located immediately posterior and superior to the pectoral fin's insertion point.
